meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 这项技能让 Claude 帮你检查或配置记忆云同步：查询是否已连接；未配置时索要三个连接值，写入设置并重启验证；最后报告同步状态、错误和隐私说明，且不会打印同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你说“set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”“cmem pro”等，或要求把记忆备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.note: 会索要 cmem.ai 的三个连接值。
会查询并报告是否已连接。

say.text: 把我的记忆同步到 cmem.ai 账号
say.note: 未配置时会引导你完成设置。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude check or set up memory cloud sync: it queries status, asks for three connection values if unset, saves them, restarts, verifies, and reports state/errors with a privacy note. It never prints the sync token.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like “set up cloud sync”, “sync my memories”, “cmem pro”, or a request to back up/sync the memory database to cmem.ai.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync for me.
say_en.note: It will ask you for the three cmem.ai connection values.
It queries and reports whether the connection is configured.

say_en.text: Sync my memories to my cmem.ai account.
say_en.note: If not configured, it walks you through setup.
